# Read dataset and summarize data for each CoupleID
## Batch 8 and 9
```{r}

#Read database
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "Combined_dataset_Batch89_complete.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE)) #753 rows

## Convert into factor
data <- data  |> 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(PetriNumber = as.factor(PetriNumber)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID = as.factor(CoupleID))

## Correct names of F1 and F2
data <- data |>
  dplyr::mutate(Male = dplyr::if_else(grepl("-", Male),
      dplyr::if_else(Batch == 8,
        sub("^(.*)-(.*)$", "F1 \\1x\\2", Male),
        sub("^(.*)-(.*)$", "F2 \\1x\\2x\\1x\\2", Male)),Male)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Female = dplyr::if_else(grepl("-", Female),
      dplyr::if_else(Batch == 8,
        sub("^(.*)-(.*)$", "F1 \\1x\\2", Female),
        sub("^(.*)-(.*)$", "F2 \\1x\\2x\\1x\\2", Female)), Female)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = paste(Female, Male, sep = "x"))

##Summarize data for each CoupleID (272 rows)
merged_data <- data |>
  dplyr::group_by(CoupleID, CrossType, Female, Male, Batch, Block, Year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(sum_eggcount_corr = sum(EggCountCorr),
                   sum_larvacount = sum(LarvaeCount))

## Compute hatch rate for each CoupleID
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = sum_larvacount / sum_eggcount_corr) 

##Save file with data for each coupleID
write.table(x = merged_data, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID_Batch89.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

```
# Fit zero-inflated GLMM with Batch 8 and Batch 9 to estimate mean hatch rate and confidence intervals

## Fit one zero-inflated model for all the data 
```{r}
library(rlang)

#Load the data 
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID_Batch89.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

# Fit m1 model for all the data in Batch8 and Batch9
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(hatchrate ~ -1 + CrossType + (1| CoupleID), data=merged_data, ziformula=~ 1 , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
#glmmTMB::diagnose(fit=m1)
summary(m1)

#Estimation of hatch rate from binomial part of the model
(p2 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$cond)))

#Estimation of confidence intervals
## Refit model nsim=500 times
b1 <- lme4::bootMer(m1, FUN=extract_model, nsim=500, .progress="txt")
  
##Confidence intervals estimation
confint_F1 <- bCI_tab(b=b1)
  
##Extract data
confintp2_F1 <- confint_F1[grepl("cond", rownames(confint_F1)),]
  
confintp2_F1 <- as.data.frame(confintp2_F1) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "type")

## Export files for the table S4
write.table(x = confintp2_F1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_F1_F2_model_m1.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

```

# Fit models to test genetic effects

```{r, eval=TRUE}
library (rlang)

#Load the data 
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID_Batch89.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Compute proportion of eggs that hatch into larvae
merged_data$prop <- merged_data$sum_larvacount / merged_data$sum_eggcount_corr
  
## Subset the data with a single type of cross (87 rows)
strains <- c("Par6", "Bal", "F1 Par6xBal", "F1 BalxPar6", "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal", "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6")
crosstype <- paste0("Amx", strains)
dat_g <- merged_data[merged_data$CrossType%in%crosstype, ]

## Export files
write.table(x = dat_g, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CoupleID_test_cross.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
  
## Variable to fit different variances for F2 vs. the other crosstypes
dat_g$vargroup <- as.factor(grepl("F2", dat_g$CrossType)*1)

## Levels of factor Crosstype
levels(as.factor(dat_g$CrossType))

## Variable for autosomal effect (Par6: -1, Bal: +1, F1/F2: 0)
dat_g$alpha1 <- as.factor(dat_g$CrossType)
levels(dat_g$alpha1) <- c(1, 0, 0, 0, 0,-1) # alphabetical order
dat_g$alpha1 <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_g$alpha1))

## Variable for dominance (Par6/Bal: 0, F1: +1, F2: 0.5)
dat_g$dominance <- as.factor(dat_g$CrossType)
levels(dat_g$dominance) <- c(0, 1, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 0)
dat_g$dominance <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_g$dominance))

## Variable for cytoplasm (Par6 or Bal depending on the mother/grandmother)
dat_g$cyto <- as.factor(dat_g$CrossType)
levels(dat_g$cyto) <- c("Bal", "Bal", "Par6", "Bal",  "Par6", "Par6")

## Variable for X effect (Par6: -1, Bal: +1, F1: -1 (Par6 mother) or +1 (Bal mother), F2: 0)
dat_g$X <- as.factor(dat_g$CrossType)
levels(dat_g$X) <- c(1, 1, -1, 0, 0, -1)
dat_g$X <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_g$X))

## Variable for Y effect (Par6: -1, Bal: +1, F1: -1 (Par6 father) or +1 (Bal father), F2: -1 (Par6 grandfather) or +1 (Bal grandfather))
dat_g$Y <- as.factor(dat_g$CrossType)
levels(dat_g$Y) <- c("Bal", "Par6", "Bal", "Par6",  "Bal", "Par6")


## Fit saturated model (generation x cross direction)
m0 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~  -1 + CrossType + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat_g, ziformula=~ -1 + CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m0)
#glmmTMB::diagnose(m0)

## Cytoplasmic effect (with CrossType In (function (start, objective, gradient = NULL, hessian = NULL,  : NA/NaN function evaluation)
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ -1 + cyto + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat_g, ziformula=~  -1 + CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m1)
#glmmTMB::diagnose(m1)

## Additive autosomal effect
m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + (1 | CoupleID) , data=dat_g, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m2)
#glmmTMB::diagnose(m2)

## X effect (does not converge)
m3 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ X + (1 | CoupleID) , data=dat_g, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m3)
#glmmTMB::diagnose(m3)

## Cytoplasmic and additive autosomal effects
m4 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + cyto + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat_g, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m4)
#glmmTMB::diagnose(m4)

## Autosomal additive and dominance effects
m5 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + dominance + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat_g, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m5)
#glmmTMB::diagnose(m5)

## Cytoplasmic, additive autosomal and dominance autosomal effects
m6 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + dominance + cyto + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat_g, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m6)
#glmmTMB::diagnose(m6)

## Effect of X, additive autosomal and dominance autosomal effects
m7 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + X + dominance + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat_g, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m7)
#glmmTMB::diagnose(m7)

##Y effect, autosomal additive and dominance effects
m8 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + dominance +Y + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat_g, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m8)

## Y effect, cytoplasmic, additive autosomal and dominance autosomal effects
m9 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + dominance + cyto +Y + (1| CoupleID) , data=dat_g, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m9) # Y effect is not identifiable, beccause difference in the reciprocal crosses could be due to the cytoplasmic effect or Y effect
#glmmTMB::diagnose(m6)

aic <- as.data.frame (MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6, m7, m8))

write.csv(
  tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(aic), "model"),
  file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "AICc_genetic_effect_F1_F2_Y.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

#Prediction of hatch rate depending on the proportion of Bal genes in the genome (?)
newdata <- expand.grid(alpha1 = c(-1, 0, 1), dominance = -1, sum_eggcount_corr=100)
newdata$prop_Bal <- (newdata$alpha1 + 1)/2

## Add CrossType otherwise the prediction does not work
newdata$CrossType <- "AmxBal"
newdata$pred.cond <- predict(m5, type="conditional", re.form=NA, newdata=newdata)

```

# Plot hatch rate data
```{r, eval=TRUE}

## Read data
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_F1_F2.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

head(data)

#Make column with CrossType
data <- data |>
dplyr::mutate(CrossType = sub(".*CrossType", "", type))

data <- data |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Filter cross types only for test cross to have observed line means
observed <- data |>
dplyr:: filter (CrossType %in% c ("AmxBal","AmxPar6","AmxF1 Par6xBal","AmxF1 BalxPar6", "AmxF2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal","AmxF2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6"))

##Add Cross and Strain to the observed line means
observed <- observed |>
dplyr:: mutate (Cross=c(rep("P1", 1), rep("P2", 1), rep("F1", 1), rep("F2", 1), rep("F1", 1), rep("F2", 1))) |>
dplyr:: mutate (Strain= infstrain)

## Expected lines means
expected <- data.frame(Cross=c("P1", "P2", "F1", "F2"), prop_Bal =c(1, 0, 0.5, 0.5), expected_hatchrate = c(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"][2], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Par6"][2], mean(c(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Par6"][2], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"][2])), mean(c(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Par6"][2], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"][2]))))

dat <- dplyr::left_join(observed, expected, by="Cross") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Strain=factor(Strain, levels=c("Bal","Par6","F1 Par6xBal","F1 BalxPar6", "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal","F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6")))

dat <- dat |>
dplyr::distinct(Strain, .keep_all = TRUE)

#Prediction of the hatch rate depending on the proportion of Bal genes for the line in the figure
##Fit m2 model for additive effect only with parental strains (Additive autosomal effect)
###Load the data 
 merged_data_p <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CoupleID_test_cross.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

strains <- c("Par6", "Bal")
crosstype <- paste0("Amx", strains)
dat_p <- merged_data_p[merged_data_p$CrossType%in%crosstype, ]

#Define variable for autosomal effect (Par6: -1, Bal:1)
dat_p$alpha1 <- as.factor(dat_p$CrossType)
levels(dat_p$alpha1) <- c(1, -1) # alphabetical order
dat_p$alpha1 <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_p$alpha1))

m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + (1 | CoupleID) , data=dat_p, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m2)
glmmTMB::diagnose(m2)

newdata <- expand.grid(alpha1 = c(-1, 0, 1), dominance = -1, sum_eggcount_corr=100)
newdata$prop_Bal <- (newdata$alpha1 + 1)/2
newdata$prop_Par6 <- 1-newdata$prop_Bal

## Add CrossType
newdata$CrossType <- "AmxBal"
newdata$pred.cond <- predict(m2, type="conditional", re.form=NA, newdata=newdata)

#Download data for CoupleID
data_couple <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CoupleID_test_cross.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE)) #272 rows

#Add to CoupleID data proportion of Bal genes
dat_couple <- dplyr::left_join(data_couple, dat, by="CrossType") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Strain=factor(Strain, levels=c("Bal","Par6","F1 Par6xBal","F1 BalxPar6", "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal","F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6")))

dat_couple$Strain_label <- dplyr::recode(
  dat_couple$Strain,
  "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" = "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)",
  "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" = "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)"
)

#Change proportion of Bal genes for the figure
dat_couple <- dat_couple |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    prop_Bal = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ 0.46,
      Strain == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ 0.485,
      Strain == "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" ~ 0.51,
      Strain == "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" ~ 0.535,
      TRUE ~ prop_Bal ) )

dat_couple$prop_Par6 <- 1-dat_couple$prop_Bal

#Change strain names for F2
dat$Strain_label <- dplyr::recode(
  dat$Strain,
  "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" = "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)",
  "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" = "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)"
)

dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    prop_Bal = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain_label == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ 0.46,
      Strain_label == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ 0.485,
      Strain_label == "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" ~ 0.51,
      Strain_label == "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" ~ 0.535,
      TRUE ~ prop_Bal))

dat$prop_Par6 <- 1-dat$prop_Bal

#Make columns for coordinates of labeles in the plot 
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_x = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain == "Par6" ~ prop_Par6 + 0.05,
      Strain == "Bal" ~ prop_Par6 - 0.05,
      Strain == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ prop_Par6 + 0.135,
      Strain == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ prop_Par6 + 0.145,
      Strain == "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" ~ prop_Par6 - 0.260,
      Strain == "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" ~ prop_Par6 - 0.240,
      TRUE ~ prop_Par6
    ),
    label_y = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain == "Par6" ~ Estimate + 0.07,
      Strain == "Bal" ~ Estimate - 0.05,
      Strain == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ Estimate + 0.03,
      Strain == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ Estimate + 0.06,
      Strain == "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" ~ Estimate + 0.02,
      Strain == "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" ~ Estimate + 0.02,
      TRUE ~ Estimate
    )
  )

## Figure 5 with hatch rate in F1 anf F2 of crosses Bal and Par6 lines
pBal <- ggplot() +
  geom_jitter(data = dat_couple, aes(x = prop_Par6, y = hatchrate, color = Strain_label), width = 0.005, height = 0, size = 9, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(data = dat, aes(x = prop_Par6, ymin = X2.5., ymax = X97.5.), width = 0.04, linewidth = 3.9, color = "black") +
  geom_point(data = dat, aes(x = prop_Par6, y = Estimate, fill = Strain_label), size = 45, shape = 21, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", stroke = 4.5) +
  geom_text(data = dat, aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = Strain_label, color = Strain_label), size = 30, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(data = newdata, aes(x = prop_Par6, y = pred.cond), color = "black", linewidth = 1.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Par6" = "violet", "Bal" = "#F8766D", "F1 Par6xBal" = "#00B6EB", "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094", "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" = "#53B400", "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" = "#A58AFF")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Par6" = "violet", "Bal" = "#F8766D", "F1 Par6xBal" = "#00B6EB", "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094", "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" = "#53B400", "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" = "#A58AFF")) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of supressor allele(s)", y = "Hatch rate in test cross", color = "Male strain") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 90, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 60)), plot.margin = margin(t = 120, r = 90, b = 120, l = 120), axis.text = element_text(size = 75), axis.title = element_text(size = 90, face = "bold"), axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 60)), axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 60)), legend.position = "none")


pBal
#save bar plot
title_plot <- "Hatch_rate_F1_F2_Par6_Balv3.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   pBal, base_height = 30/cm(1),
                   base_width = 40/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

```{r, eval=TRUE}

head(data)

dplyr::mutate(CrossType = sub(".*CrossType", "", type))

dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Filter cross types only for test cross to have observed line means
observed <- data |>
dplyr:: filter (CrossType %in% c ("AmxBal","AmxPar6","AmxF1 Par6xBal","AmxF1 BalxPar6", "AmxF2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal","AmxF2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6"))

dplyr::mutate(Strain = sub("^Amx", "", CrossType))

    ),

      Strain_label == "Par6" ~ Mortality + 0.075,
      Strain_label == "Bal" ~ Mortality + 0.05,
      Strain_label == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ Mortality - 0.05,
      TRUE ~ Mortality
    )
  )

## Figure 6 with hatch rate in F1 anf F2 of crosses Bal and Par6 lines
pBal <- ggplot() +
  geom_jitter(data = dat_couple, aes(x = prop_Bal, y = mortality, color = Strain), width = 0.005, height = 0, size = 3, alpha = 0.6 ) + #row data for CoupleID color = "grey40"
  geom_errorbar(data = dat, aes(x = prop_Bal, ymin = X2.5m, ymax = X97.5m), width = 0.04, size = 1.3, alpha = 0.4, color = "black") + #confidence intervals
  geom_point(data = dat, aes(x = prop_Bal, y = Mortality, fill = Strain), size = 15, shape = 21, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", stroke = 1.5) + #Mean hatch rate estimation from the model
  geom_text(data = dat, aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = Strain_label, color = Strain), size = 10, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) + #labels of strains
  geom_line(data = newdata, aes(x = prop_Bal, y = pred.mortality), color = "black" ) + #line with predicted estimation from additive model , linewidth = 0.5
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Par6" = "#A58AFF", "Bal" = "#F8766D", "F1 Par6xBal" = "royalblue", "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094", "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" = "#53B400", "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" = "violet")) + #colors for each strain
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Par6" = "#A58AFF", "Bal" = "#F8766D", "F1 Par6xBal" = "royalblue", "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094", "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" = "#53B400", "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" = "violet")) + #colors for each strain
  labs(x = "Proportion of Bal genes", y = "Embryo mortality rate in test cross", color = "Male strain") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)), plot.margin = margin(t = 40, r = 30, b = 40, l = 40), axis.text = element_text(size = 25), axis.title = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"), axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 20)), axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 20)), legend.position = "none")


pBal
```

# Plot predicted hatch rate for different genetic models

## Plot for predicted F1 and F2 with cytoplasmic effect Par6 / Bal
```{r, eval=FALSE}

###Load the data 
merged_data_p <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CoupleID_test_cross.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

strains <- c("Par6", "Bal")
crosstype <- paste0("Amx", strains)
dat_p <- merged_data_p[merged_data_p$CrossType%in%crosstype, ]

#Define variable for autosomal effect (Par6: -1, Bal:1)
dat_p$alpha1 <- as.factor(dat_p$CrossType)
levels(dat_p$alpha1) <- c(1, -1) # alphabetical order
dat_p$alpha1 <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_p$alpha1))

m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + (1 | CoupleID) , data=dat_p, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m2)
glmmTMB::diagnose(m2)

newdata <- expand.grid(alpha1 = c(-1, 0, 1), dominance = -1, sum_eggcount_corr=100)
newdata$prop_Bal <- (newdata$alpha1 + 1)/2
newdata$prop_Par6 <- 1-newdata$prop_Bal

## Add CrossType
newdata$CrossType <- "AmxBal"
newdata$pred.cond <- predict(m2, type="conditional", re.form=NA, newdata=newdata)

# Make database and add proportion of Bal and Par6 genes
## Read data
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confintp2_F1_F2.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

#Make column with CrossType
data <- data |>
dplyr::mutate(CrossType = sub(".*CrossType", "", type))

data <- data |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Filter cross types only for test cross to have observed line means
observed <- data |>
dplyr:: filter (CrossType %in% c ("AmxBal","AmxPar6","AmxF1 Par6xBal","AmxF1 BalxPar6", "AmxF2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal","AmxF2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6"))

##Add Cross and Strain to the observed line means
observed <- observed |>
dplyr:: mutate (Cross=c(rep("P1", 1), rep("P2", 1), rep("F1", 1), rep("F2", 1), rep("F1", 1), rep("F2", 1))) |>
dplyr:: mutate (Strain= infstrain)
## Expected lines means
expected <- data.frame(Cross=c("P1", "P2", "F1", "F2"), prop_Bal =c(1, 0, 0.5, 0.5), expected_hatchrate = c(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"][2], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Par6"][2], mean(c(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Par6"][2], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"][2])), mean(c(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Par6"][2], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"][2]))))

dat <- dplyr::left_join(observed, expected, by="Cross") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Strain=factor(Strain, levels=c("Bal","Par6","F1 Par6xBal","F1 BalxPar6", "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal","F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6")))

#Add predicted values for cytoplasmic effect
dat$cytopl <- dat$Estimate

cytopl_Par6 <- dat |> dplyr::filter(Strain == "Par6") |> dplyr::pull(cytopl) |> dplyr::first()
cytopl_bal <- dat |> dplyr::filter(Strain == "Bal") |> dplyr::pull(cytopl) |> dplyr::first()

dat <- dat |> dplyr::mutate(
    cytopl = dplyr::case_when(
     stringr::str_detect(Strain, "^(F1|F2) Par6x") ~ cytopl_Par6,
    stringr::str_detect(Strain, "^(F1|F2) Balx") ~ cytopl_bal,
      TRUE ~ cytopl))

dat <- dat |>
dplyr::distinct(Strain, .keep_all = TRUE)

#Add proportion of Par6 genes 
dat$prop_Par6 <- 1-dat$prop_Bal

#Change proportion of Par6 for the figure
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    prop_Par6 = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ 0.460,
      Strain == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ 0.460,
      Strain == "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" ~ 0.535,
      Strain == "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" ~ 0.535,
      TRUE ~ prop_Par6))

#Change strain names for F2
dat$Strain_label <- dplyr::recode(
  dat$Strain,
  "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" = "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)",
  "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" = "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)")

#Make columns for coordinates of labeles in the plot 
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_x = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain_label == "Par6" ~ prop_Par6 + 0.06,
      Strain_label == "Bal" ~ prop_Par6 + 0.02,
      Strain_label == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ prop_Par6 - 0.12,
      Strain_label == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ prop_Par6 - 0.12,
      Strain_label == "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" ~ prop_Par6 + 0.20,
      Strain_label == "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" ~ prop_Par6 + 0.20,
      TRUE ~ prop_Par6
    ),
    label_y = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain_label == "Par6" ~ cytopl + 0.1,
      Strain_label == "Bal" ~ cytopl + 0.1,
      Strain_label == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ cytopl - 0.07,
      Strain_label == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ cytopl - 0.07,
      Strain_label == "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" ~ cytopl + 0.08,
      Strain_label == "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" ~ cytopl + 0.08,
      TRUE ~ cytopl
    )
  )

## Predicted hatch rate for cytoplasmic effect

pBal1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = newdata, aes(x = prop_Par6, y = pred.cond), color = "black", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = dat, aes(x = prop_Par6, y = cytopl, fill = Strain_label), size = 25, shape = 21, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_text(data = dat, aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = Strain_label, color = Strain_label), size = 10, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Par6" = "violet", "Bal" = "#F8766D", "F1 Par6xBal" = "#00B6EB", "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094", "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" = "#53B400", "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" = "#A58AFF")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Par6" = "violet", "Bal" = "#F8766D", "F1 Par6xBal" = "#00B6EB", "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094", "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" = "#53B400", "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" = "#A58AFF")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0",  "0.5", "1"), expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5","1"), expand = c(0, 0.02)) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of supressor allele(s)", y = "Hatch rate in test cross", title = "Cytoplasmic effect") +
  annotate("segment", x = -0.1, xend = 1.03, y = 0, yend = 0, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.6, "cm")), linewidth = 1.2, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = -0.1, xend = -0.1, y = 0, yend = 1.03, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.6, "cm")), linewidth = 1.2, color = "black") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.1, 1.03), ylim = c(0, 1.03), clip = "off") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 60, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)), plot.margin = margin(t = 40, r = 60, b = 40, l = 40), axis.text = element_text(size = 40, color = "black"), axis.title = element_text(size = 50, face = "bold", color = "black"), axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 20)), axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 20)), axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

pBal1
#save bar plot
title_plot <- "Hatch_rate_F1_F2_Par6_Bal_cytopl.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   pBal1, base_height = 30/cm(1),
                   base_width = 40/cm(1), dpi = 1200)

# Only for F1

dat2<- dat |>

## Predicted embryo mortality for cytoplasmic effect

pBal1_F1 <- ggplot() +
```

## Plot for predicted F1 and F2 with dominant effect Par6 / Bal
```{r, eval=FALSE}

#Add proportion of Par6 genes 
dat$prop_Par6 <- 1-dat$prop_Bal

#Add predicted values for dominance effect

    dominance = dplyr::case_when(
```

## Plot for predicted F1 and F2 with cytoplasmic effect Par6 / Bal
```{r, eval=FALSE}

#Prediction of mortality depending on the proportion of Bal genes for the line in the figure

##Fit m2 model for additive effect only with parental strains (Additive autosomal effect)
###Load the data 
merged_data_p <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CoupleID_test_cross.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

strains <- c("Par6", "Bal")
crosstype <- paste0("Amx", strains)
dat_p <- merged_data_p[merged_data_p$CrossType%in%crosstype, ]

#Define variable for autosomal effect (Par6: -1, Bal:1)
dat_p$alpha1 <- as.factor(dat_p$CrossType)
levels(dat_p$alpha1) <- c(1, -1) # alphabetical order
dat_p$alpha1 <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_p$alpha1))

m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + (1 | CoupleID) , data=dat_p, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m2)
glmmTMB::diagnose(m2)

newdata <- expand.grid(alpha1 = c(-1, 0, 1), dominance = -1, sum_eggcount_corr=100)
newdata$prop_Bal <- (newdata$alpha1 + 1)/2

## Add CrossType
newdata$CrossType <- "AmxBal"
newdata$pred.cond <- predict(m2, type="conditional", re.form=NA, newdata=newdata)

#Mortality for the line in the figure

newdata$pred.mortality <- 1- newdata$pred.cond

#Add predicted values for cytoplasmic effect
dat$cytopl <- dat$Mortality

cytopl_Par6 <- dat |> dplyr::filter(Strain == "Par6") |> dplyr::pull(cytopl) |> dplyr::first()
cytopl_bal <- dat |> dplyr::filter(Strain == "Bal") |> dplyr::pull(cytopl) |> dplyr::first()

dat <- dat |> dplyr::mutate(
    cytopl = dplyr::case_when(
     stringr::str_detect(Strain, "^(F1|F2) Par6x") ~ cytopl_Par6,
    stringr::str_detect(Strain, "^(F1|F2) Balx") ~ cytopl_bal,
      TRUE ~ cytopl))

dat <- dat |>
dplyr::distinct(Strain, .keep_all = TRUE)

#Change proportion of Bal for the figure
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    prop_Bal = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ 0.460,
      Strain == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ 0.460,
      Strain == "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" ~ 0.535,
      Strain == "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" ~ 0.535,
      TRUE ~ prop_Bal
    )
  )

#Make columns for coordinates of labeles in the plot 
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_x = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain_label == "Par6" ~ prop_Bal + 0.06,
      Strain_label == "Bal" ~ prop_Bal + 0.02,
      Strain_label == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ prop_Bal - 0.12,
      Strain_label == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ prop_Bal - 0.12,
      Strain_label == "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" ~ prop_Bal + 0.20,
      Strain_label == "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" ~ prop_Bal + 0.20,
      TRUE ~ prop_Bal
    ),
    label_y = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain_label == "Par6" ~ cytopl + 0.1,
      Strain_label == "Bal" ~ cytopl + 0.1,
      Strain_label == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ cytopl - 0.07,
      Strain_label == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ cytopl - 0.07,
      Strain_label == "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" ~ cytopl + 0.08,
      Strain_label == "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" ~ cytopl + 0.08,
      TRUE ~ cytopl
    )
  )

## Predicted embryo mortality for cytoplasmic effect

pBal1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = newdata, aes(x = prop_Bal, y = pred.mortality), color = "black", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 1.5) +
```

## Plot for predicted F1 and F2 with dominant effect Par6 / Bal
```{r, eval=FALSE}

#Add predicted values for dominance effect
dat$dominance <- dat$Mortality

par6 <- dat |>
  dplyr::filter(Strain == "Par6") |>
  dplyr::pull(dominance) |>
  dplyr::first()

bal <- dat |>
  dplyr::filter(Strain == "Bal") |>
  dplyr::pull(dominance) |>
  dplyr::first()


dom_F1 <- par6
dom_F2 <- par6 + (bal - par6) * 0.25

dat <- dat |> dplyr::mutate(
    dominance = dplyr::case_when(
     stringr::str_detect(Strain, "F1 ") ~ dom_F1,
    stringr::str_detect(Strain, "F2 ") ~ dom_F2,
      TRUE ~ dominance))

#Change proportion of Bal for the figure
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    prop_Bal = dplyr::case_when(
```

## Plot for predicted F1 and F2 with autosomal additive effect Par6 / Bal
```{r, eval=FALSE}

## Observed line means
dat <- data.frame(Strain= c(rep("Par6", 1), rep("Bal", 1), rep("F1 Par6xBal", 1), rep("F1 BalxPar6", 1), rep("F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal", 1), rep("F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6", 1)), Cross=c(rep("P1", 1), rep("P2", 1), rep("F1", 2), rep("F2", 2)), prop_Par6 =c(1, 0, 0.495, 0.505,0.49, 0.51), observed_hatch_rate = c(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Par6"][2], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"][2],
ifelse(sum(data$infstrain=="F1 Par6xBal")==1, data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F1 Par6xBal"], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F1 Par6xBal"][2]),
ifelse(sum(data$infstrain=="F1 BalxPar6")==1, data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F1 BalxPar6"], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F1 BalxPar6"][2]),
ifelse(sum(data$infstrain=="F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal")==1, data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal"], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal"][2]),
ifelse(sum(data$infstrain=="F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6")==1, data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6"], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6"][2])))

#Add predicted values for autosomal additive effect
dat$ad <- dat$observed_hatch_rate

adit <- newdata |> dplyr::filter(alpha1 == "0") |> dplyr::pull(pred.cond) |> dplyr::first()


dat <- dat |> dplyr::mutate(
    ad = dplyr::case_when(
     stringr::str_detect(Strain, "F") ~ adit,
     TRUE ~ ad))


## Predicted hatch rate for autosomal additive effect

pBal <- dat %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=prop_Par6, y=ad, color=Strain))  + 
  #geom_jitter(width = 0.005, size=5, height = 0) +
  geom_point(size=20, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
  aes(label = Strain),
  size = 20,
  nudge_y = 0.03,
  segment.color = NA,
  show.legend = FALSE
) + 
  geom_line(data = newdata, aes(x = prop_Par6, y = pred.cond, color="black")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Par6" = "violet",
      "Bal" = "#F8766D",
      "F1 Par6xBal" = "#00B6EB",
      "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094",
      "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" = "#53B400",
      "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" = "#A58AFF"))+
  labs(x = "Proportion of Par6 genes", y = "Hatch rate in cross W- X W+ ") +   ggtitle("Predicted hatch rate in CI cross for autosomal additive effect") +
#  xlim(0, 1) +
#  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"), axis.text = element_text(size = 40),
axis.title=element_text(size=40, face="bold"), legend.position="none")

pBal

#save bar plot
title_plot <- "Hatch_rate_F1_F2_Par6_Bal_ad.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   pBal, base_height = 40/cm(1),
                   base_width = 50/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```
